```{r}
library(dplyr)

genes <- c(
  "Twf2",
  "Bag3",
  "Dync1li2",
  "Gss",
  "Rbx1",
  "Slc17a7",
  "Slc17a1",
  "Slc17a8",
  "Slc17a6",
  "Nfrkb",
  "Xylt2",
  "Sapcd2",
  "Tmem167a"
)

candidate_table <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(genes, function(g) {

    expr <- FetchData(E15_AP, vars = g)[,1]

    data.frame(
      Gene = g,
      MeanExpr = round(mean(expr), 3),
      PercentExpressing = round(100 * mean(expr > 0), 1),
      NumCellsExpressing = sum(expr > 0),
      MaxExpr = round(max(expr), 3)
    )

  })
)

candidate_table <- candidate_table %>%
  arrange(desc(PercentExpressing))

candidate_table

# Save table
write.csv(
  candidate_table,
  "E15_AP_candidate_expression_table.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
